precoro_expense_approved_trigger.description: Runs when an expense is approved.

output.expense: The record returned by the service

precoro_invoice_approved_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is approved.

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

precoro_invoice_paid_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is paid in full.

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_credit_note_trigger.description: Runs when a credit note is created.

output.creditNote: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_expense_trigger.description: Runs when an expense is created.

output.expense: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is created (credit notes have their own trigger).

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_item_trigger.description: Runs when an item is added to your catalog.

output.item: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs when a payment is recorded on an invoice or purchase order.

output.payment: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_purchase_order_trigger.description: Runs when a purchase order is created.

output.purchaseOrder: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_purchase_requisition_trigger.description: Runs when a purchase requisition is created.

output.purchaseRequisition: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_receipt_trigger.description: Runs when a receipt of delivered goods is created.

output.receipt: The record returned by the service

precoro_new_supplier_trigger.description: Runs when a supplier is added.

output.supplier: The record returned by the service

precoro_purchase_order_approved_trigger.description: Runs when a purchase order is approved.

output.purchaseOrder: The record returned by the service

precoro_purchase_order_status_changed_tr.description: Runs when a purchase order's status changes, such as being approved, rejected, received or closed.

output.purchaseOrder: The record returned by the service

precoro_purchase_order_updated_trigger.description: Runs when anything on a purchase order changes.

output.purchaseOrder: The record returned by the service

precoro_purchase_requisition_approved_tr.description: Runs when a purchase requisition is approved.

output.purchaseRequisition: The record returned by the service

precoro_purchase_requisition_status_chan.description: Runs when a purchase requisition's status changes, such as being submitted, approved, rejected or purchased.

output.purchaseRequisition: The record returned by the service

precoro_receipt_approved_trigger.description: Runs when a receipt is approved.

output.receipt: The record returned by the service

precoro_supplier_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a supplier's details change.

output.supplier: The record returned by the service
